_comments: UI role permissions for Collaboration entities, matching the row-level security boundaries.

RELEASE SEED NOTE FOR BUILD ENGINEER: The UI entity permission rows for Collaboration entities (Spaces, Space Members, Space Items, Share Notices, Item Uses) come from the CodeGen output appended to this repo's migrations (V202609222231__v0.1.x__Tables.sql and V202609230620__v0.1.x__Library_CodeGen.sql). Because they are inserted without fixed IDs, every host has its own IDs. When generating the release Metadata_Sync SQL, ensure updates to these permissions are keyed by EntityID and RoleID (matching UI role) rather than capture-database permission IDs, so that CodeGen's default unfiltered UI permissions are properly updated with these RLS filters on every target host (following the pattern other apps already use).
